description: vornik-companion SessionStart hooks. On a NEW session (startup/resume/clear/fork) it fetches a digest of recent delegations + project memory chunks and plants the standing directives (repo_scope auto-detected from the cwd's git remote, RAG-first, skill capture). On COMPACT it re-plants the directives only — compaction discards them at the point a long session has already lost the most context, and reprinting the delegation digest would spend the context the compaction just freed. Registered with explicit matchers because SessionStart has no `source` field on stdin: the matcher is the only way a hook learns why it fired.
